name: magpie-harness-quota
description: Optional Magpie CLI quota source for Antigravity (AGY CLI) harness instances.

interface.shortDescription: Read Antigravity account allowances via official Magpie CLI

magpiePath.title: Magpie executable
magpiePath.description: Optional absolute path to the official magpie[.exe] binary. Leave empty to resolve magpie from PATH.

zh.title: Magpie 可执行文件
zh.description: 可选的官方 magpie[.exe] 绝对路径；留空时从 PATH 查找。

modelWindows.title: Model window mappings (JSON)
modelWindows.description: JSON object mapping exact native AGY model IDs to Magpie pool/name windows, e.g. {"gemini-4-argon-high":{"pool":"Gemini 4 Argon"},"claude-opus-5-5-high":{"pool":"Claude & GPT","name":"5 hours"}}.

zh.title: 模型额度池映射（JSON）
zh.description: 将精确原生 AGY 模型 ID 映射到 Magpie 的 pool/name 窗口，例如 {"gemini-4-argon-high":{"pool":"Gemini 4 Argon"},"claude-opus-5-5-high":{"pool":"Claude & GPT","name":"5 hours"}}。
